tool_args.rationale: Acquire the trajectory batch to distinguish and numerically fit the coupled memory-kernel ODE using the irregular raw prefixes.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the coupled memory ODE to the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The four-parameter coupled model is insufficiently identified by five rows; the archived mechanism specifies at least eight.
The observed history gap and transient lag point to the memory mechanism, not a sink-gradient branch.
It does not explicitly represent the history-dependent lag indicated by the pilot signatures.
